original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳劳工部长呼吁国有企业参与制定新公共薪酬体系
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳劳工、就业与劳资关系部长Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum呼吁国有企业首席执行官积极参与该国拟议的新公共部门薪酬体系制定。他表示，政府并非要强加外国模式，而是希望在广泛协商和公共部门利益相关者经验基础上，建立本土化、可持续的体系。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 加纳劳工部长呼吁国有企业首席执行官参与制定新的公共部门薪酬体系
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Minister for Labour, Jobs and Employment, Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum, has urged Chief Executives of State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) to actively contribute to the development of Ghana’s proposed new public sector compensation system.

key_facts.fact: 部长称政府并非要强加外国模式，而是建立本土化可持续体系
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mr Agyekum said the government was not seeking to impose a foreign model but to develop a home-grown, sustainable system based on broad consultation and the experiences of stakeholders within the public sector.

uncertainties: 该报道目前仅有一个来源（MyJoyOnline），尚缺乏交叉验证
